main.why: Your child can wander the galleries at Member Monday: Ancient Nubia, then burn off energy at NC Museum of Art Museum Park, with its lawns, trails and big outdoor art.
tips: Let {them} point at what catches {their} eye and move on when {they} {is} ready.

Say goodbye to the big art, then walk to the car holding a favorite toy.

plans.headline: Toddle the forest greenway and spot leaves

main.why: A slow morning in the woods. Your toddler can walk the greenway, pick up leaves and sticks, and stop to look at whatever is on the ground.
tips: Let {them} set the pace and choose where to stop.
Bring a snack and eat it at the picnic shelter before you go.
Leave with a leaf or stick to carry to the car.
